description.zh: 由容器管理的 @deepseek-ai/dsh profile「web」，插件在本机 userData 的 profile 目录内管理
description.en: Container-managed @deepseek-ai/dsh profile "web"; plugins are managed in this machine’s userData profile directory

description.zh: 默认使用独立目录（容器独占，环境根目录下的 .dsh 子目录）；若未手动改动且 ~/.dsh 已有登录会自动沿用以免丢失；选系统通用目录则与终端共用同一套 profile（~/.dsh）
description.en: Uses a container-owned .dsh subfolder of the env root by default; until you change it, an existing ~/.dsh login is kept automatically so nothing is lost. Pick the system-common folder to share the CLI profile store (~/.dsh)
